messages:
maria-support: Heads up — ACME (acct: ACME-Corp, invoice #INV-2026-0042) hit a payment hold. They requested Net60 in procurement but PO (PO-88971) we received is unsigned, and their company card attempt failed. Finance is refusing to clear until a signed PO or prepayment. Need escalation and quick options. :grimacing:

jack-finance: Do we have confirmation they requested Net60 in the SOW? Policy: Net>30 needs PO + legal approval for amounts >$10k. Amount here is $12,450 — higher risk.

leo-sales: Confirmed Net60 in SOW. Procurement now says they won't sign PO until VAT/branch details sorted (EU VAT / reverse-charge question). Sales is asking if we can accept a scanned PO + VAT ID in interim.

nina-accounts: If they're EU B2B with a valid VAT ID we can apply reverse charge, but we need the VAT number on file + a signed PO referencing our T&Cs for accounting. I can draft a VAT addendum they can countersign.

maria-support: Screenshot attached of the billing system failure. Billing bot logged a decline. Customer claims company card blocks charges >$5k without an explicit PO.

billing-bot: Automated: Charge attempt for INV-2026-0042 — status: failed (card_declined). Retry scheduled in 24h. Decline code: DO_NOT_HONOR.

jack-finance: Given dollar amount, Finance can't clear without signed PO or explicit executive pre-approval. Possible short-term options: (1) accept scanned & countersigned PO within 48h and mark as provisional, (2) require Net30 instead of Net60 with immediate payment, (3) legal sign-off to allow Net60 based on VAT addendum + VAT ID.

leo-sales: Could we offer a limited-service exception while paperwork is in progress? Example: restore 50% capacity until PO is countersigned. That helps ACME continue rollout and reduces pressure. Is that permissible?

nina-accounts: We can do a temporary provisioning change only if Legal signs off on a short credit exposure waiver. Tagging legal needed. I don't have sign-off authority for exposures >$10k.

maria-support: Customer response pasted below: 
> We can provide VAT ID: EU987654321 and a scanned PO, but procurement requires the signed service order referencing Redwood's standard T&Cs before finance will release funds. They insist on PO before any charge.

jack-finance: Actionable plan: if Sales supplies a scanned signed PO referencing our T&Cs + VAT ID within 48h, Finance will mark invoice as "awaiting PO" and pause collections; we'll allow retry of the card once PO is on file. If no PO in 7 days escalate to AR lead and consider service suspension.

leo-sales: I'll get the procurement contact and push for that scanned PO. Also asking if they can authorize a manual ACH transfer to clear the outstanding balance while PO is finalized.

nina-accounts: I'm preparing the VAT addendum and will send to Legal for expedited review. If they provide VAT ID + scanned PO, we can lift the hold pending full countersignature.

maria-support: Quick technical note for the billing team: when retrying the card, please use the original token id to avoid duplicate card prompts for the customer. If decline persists, flag for manual collection.

jack-finance: Marking invoice INV-2026-0042 as 'awaiting PO' in AR. Suspending dunning / automated reminders for now. If PO not received in 7 days we re-open collections.

billing-bot: Note: Retry scheduled at 1801240000 (per earlier log).

maria-support: Action items summary:
- leo-sales: Obtain signed PO scan + VAT ID (due 48h)
- nina-accounts: Draft VAT addendum & escalate to Legal
- jack-finance: Hold collections; set AR reminder for 7-day follow-up

maria-support: I'll update the customer and keep this thread live. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
